'''Tanimbili''' (''Tanibili''), or '''Nyisunggu''', is a nearly-extinct language spoken on the island of [[Utupua]], in the easternmost province of the [[Solomon Islands]].<ref name="e18"/><ref name="DT1994">[[#DT1994|Tryon (1994)]].</ref>
